notes:
sl s2 (typed on my phone sorry)

drowned chapel under the reef
- buck read rest of logbook (learned the script lol) - salt mother = sea hag, keeper traded the light for his drowned daughter
- doro champ devotion crit? no just success, +1 next save. hit the chest w/ hammer, bounced
- pim peeked in chest untrained arcana CF, brine to face. then yeeted the chest onto the altar right to the hag 🤦
- ione talked thru the chest (dip succ) - its MARIS the daughter trapped inside as seawater kid. glafka light scout nothing
- buck jumped for altar fail, then ARM WRESTLED the hag's hand coming out of the water & lost by 1 (23 v 24) got dragged under 😭
- kestrel shot the altar 8 dmg, hag shows up + 2 drowned sailors

fight
- r1 doro nat1 smashed a pew. hag nat1 on doro too lmao
- pim improvised blinding w/ salt SUCC, hag blinded. swam to buck
- buck underwater: water ballet trip nat1, kick miss, wall run fail. fort save succ held breath
- kestrel salt-wind shot hit 7, 2nd miss
- ione begged hag to let maris go CF, cantrip missed, sailor hit her 10
- r2 doro crit the chest lock 27 🔓 buck failed to yank chest but NAT20 ripped the lid off!!
- ione fire on hag 13, shoved the sailor off her
- pim tried to tow ione to shore nat1 both sank
- kestrel shot at chest miss
- maris out, back to a girl by dawn. hag let go + melted into the tide (got away)

week in brinemouth
- doro shield drills fail, helped at fish market (dip succ), scholar lore on salt mother (arc succ), arm wrestling NAT 20 champion of the tavern 🏆
- pim dried his stuff nat1 = thieves tools ruined, tried to steal shiny fish scales fail, arm wrestling fail
- ione texts w/ scholar succ, lighthouse inscriptions fail, "θα μάθω να παλεύω με το χέρι" learned arm wrestling... fail
- buck arm wrestling AGAIN fail (3 sessions straight), taught maris a cartwheel succ ❤️, diving contest vs fisherman fail
- kestrel archery fail, gozreh temple lore succ, WON the arm wrestling tournament
- town pays half the new lens we owe the rest

next: the hag got away. bring hero points. does blinded stack w/ off-guard? ask doro lol

entry.name: Champion's Bulwark

mechanics.effect: While you are adjacent to an ally, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC and Fortitude saves against attacks from creatures you have threatened or are currently engaging.

lineage.rationale: Doro demonstrated a consistent pattern of using defensive actions (Shield Block) and taunting (Demanding Challenge) to protect allies and control enemy focus, embodying the Champion's role as a protector.

entry.system_equivalent: Champion's defensive aura or similar martial feat (Pathfinder Second Edition)

proposals.rejectedReason: permanent +1 AC to every adjacent ally is too strong at tier 1; evidence cites the logbook

evidence: Doro deciphered the keeper's logbook in the old coastal script (Society, success)

entry.name: Champion's Insight

mechanics.effect: Attempt a Society check to decipher a text, symbol, or clue. On a success, you gain one piece of relevant information. On a critical success, you gain two pieces of information or a significant advantage in the current situation.

lineage.rationale: Doro successfully deciphered a complex logbook in an old script, showing a dedicated ability to extract knowledge from obscure sources, which complements the Champion's role in understanding the world they protect.

entry.system_equivalent: Society skill action or feat (Pathfinder Second Edition)

entry.name: Champion's Devotion

mechanics.effect: Make a Religion check to gain a boon from your deity. On a success, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw or skill check. On a critical success, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus and can use this ability again immediately.
mechanics.duration: until the end of the current turn or next check

lineage.rationale: Doro made a successful offering at the temple of Gozreh, indicating a strong connection to divine power and a willingness to seek aid from their deity, which is a core aspect of the Champion class.

entry.system_equivalent: Champion's divine boon or similar feat (Pathfinder Second Edition)

entry.name: Ranger's Aim: Salt-Wind Precision

mechanics.effect: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to ranged Strikes made with a bow or crossbow when targeting a creature that is not off-guard.

lineage.rationale: Repeated successful ranged engagements, including critical hits and dedicated practice, demonstrate a growing mastery of precise archery.

entry.system_equivalent: Precision Shot feat (Pathfinder Second Edition)

entry.name: Ranger: Salt-Wind Shot

mechanics.effect: Make a ranged Strike with a bow. If the target is an aquatic or amphibious creature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. On a critical success, the target is also slowed 1 for 1 round.

lineage.rationale: Demonstrated exceptional precision and adaptability when hunting marine creatures, specifically critting a giant crab twice in one encounter.

entry.system_equivalent: Ranger class feat (Pathfinder Second Edition)

evidence: Kestrel tried to help the glassworks remake the lens and crit-failed (broke a mould)

entry.name: Ranger: Glasswright's Caution

mechanics.effect: When you attempt a Craft check to work with fragile materials (glass, crystal, etc.) and roll a critical failure, you do not break the item or tool; instead, the check is treated as a simple failure.

lineage.rationale: Learned through a costly critical failure in glassblowing, instilling a defensive instinct against shattering delicate work.

entry.system_equivalent: Craft skill feat (Pathfinder Second Edition)
